q1.q: Is this a chatbot with a script?
q1.a: No. It holds a real conversation, understands follow-up questions and answers the way your business would. No "press 1 for opening hours".

q2.q: Does it tell people it is an AI?
q2.a: Yes, in the first sentence. The law requires it, and we think it is simply honest. Then it gets on with helping.

q3.q: What if it does not know the answer?
q3.a: It says so and passes the question to you with the customer’s name and number, so you can call back. It never makes things up.

q4.q: How long before it is live?
q4.a: VangChat is usually live within a few working days. VangMessage and VangVoice take one to two weeks, because WhatsApp and phone forwarding need to be approved and set up.

q5.q: Does it work in French and English too?
q5.a: Yes. Dutch, French and English are standard, and it switches to the language the customer speaks.

q6.q: Do I keep my current phone number?
q6.a: Yes. Calls you do not pick up are forwarded to your assistant. Nothing changes for your customers.

q7.q: Do I need to be good with technology?
q7.a: No. We set everything up and keep it running. If you can send us a WhatsApp, you can work with us.

q8.q: Can I change what it says later?
q8.a: Yes. Send us your changes, like new prices, holiday hours or a new service, and we update it for you every week.

q9.a: Everything is handled under GDPR. Your customer data belongs to you and is never used to train other systems. Full explanation on

q10.a: From €50 a month for one channel, excl. VAT. The exact price depends on your business, and we give you a fixed price on a short call.
